note1: And that's a wrap to this chapter.
note2: I know it isn't the most exciting of chapters, but it had to be done. Originally, I planned a lot more for this chapter, if I were to follow through, then the sheer typing for this chapter would've been enormous, which means longer time, which means a much longer update.
note3: It also doesn't help that I had to rewrite this chapter multiple times.
note4: There were some segments I wanted to add, but I found those difficult to work with, and just scrapped them, which wasted time.
note5: I've also discovered that I have a bad habit of trying to cram in up to 20k words per chapter as of late.
note6: In actuality, the average amount of words per typical chapter for most stories (in real life) is about 1,500-5000 words.
note7: If I look at my last chapter, then I have practically crammed about roughly 4 chapters into one chapter. Wow.
note8: So I find that having 10K words per chapter is the best solution for both myself and the upload schedule, unless I needed to fit in more scenes to help with the flow.
note9: Moving on from that, uh oh, despite Sora already doing his best to remain under the radar, a couple of Gods are already starting to pick up a few things.

fun_fact2: While it is possible to hack the game to include Bahamut in the Summons menu, choosing him will crash the game.
fun_fact3: Imagine if Bahamut managed to get into Kingdom Hearts, and Sora summoned him to help out.
fun_fact4: One could only imagine the chaos that occurs and a certain blonde adventurer is going to have a heart attack/rampage upon seeing the summon.
fun_fact5: Also, even if Bahamut was summoned, Bahamut still falls short to Donald.
